groups.name: Pack words (DTW)
groups.releaseNotice: Genuine 5-word DTW model built from real ASL Citizen pack clips (all five words appear 30+ times in the full archive). 82 distinct-signer templates harvested through the app's own capture path (17 FISH / 17 PAIN / 17 SEE / 15 SICK / 16 NIGHT). Left/right-hand invariance (mirror) is enabled and required for these signs. Leave-one-participant-out on training clips: 91% correct. Held-out unseen-signer test (3 signers/word, 15 clips): 10/15 = 67% (FISH 2/3, PAIN 1/3, SEE 3/3, SICK 2/3, NIGHT 2/3). KNIGHT is a confusable negative, not a label: as a closed 5-word vocabulary it is accepted as a pack word (0/4 rejected) — review every suggestion. Per-label distance cutoffs applied. Application integration verified (the model loads, passes its SHA-256 gate, and activates in the app; recognition runs through the app's own recognizer). Live-camera accuracy with a human signer is still unverified; review every suggestion.
